spec_case: issue #442's first item, closed by #537: a tree dynamic's combined failure text names each branch's own exception class
description: A `flow: tree` dynamic (`max_concurrency: 1`, `on_error: continue`) with five branches that each fail a different way: a `tool` leaf (ValueError), a nested tree with two failing leaves of its own (TreeExecutionError, the nested combine's own class), a `use` (inline) branch (RuntimeError), an `each` loop branch (RuntimeError), and a `shell` allowlist denial (PermissionError). `fan.meta.error` names every branch's own displayed class, `err.__cause__ or err`'s one-level unwrap (`core/dynamic.py::TreeExecutionError._format`), matched by `electricity_vm::VmError::displayed_class`.
